Vakni could feel resistance as she stepped through the portal into Pome's Sanctuary, as if her presence was only being tolerated because she was a servant of Cruxius. No matter, she thought. She stepped from the beach into the forest she found before her, searching for the Illithid who were said to be nearby. It was a short search, and before long she had gathered the population of Illithid before her. "Here me, you creatures whose presence offends not one but two gods. I come from a third and a fourth, Cruxius and Zille, who have felt your plight and believe you deserve more than this wasting sickness, this lack of opportunity and stagnation inside a Sanctuary that rejects your ability to breed, and thereby dooms you to an eventual extinction. Come with me, and I can offer you the minds you so desire. A chance to begin again and a chance to prosper among the people's of Gaea, and beyond. Cruxius has mentioned to me of a place called Spalix, as well," at this, all eyes focused on the Hellite, "I see you have heard of it. Supposedly the location of such a place is within my Lord's domain, and he offers you the possibility of its discovery. All you must do is live."

The forest grew eerily silent as the Illithid communicated psionically between themselves, determining the best course of action. Some argued that they had finally found peace, and so should stay where they were safe, while others argued about the prosperity of their once-great race and the desire to bring children into the world. Among all of the ramblings, one thought grew louder in their collective the longer the conversation drew on: "Spalix!" Eventually, as the oppressive silence began to grate on Vakni, a leader stepped forth from among the assembled. "If your gods can grant us the power to bring our children into this world, or another, we will go with you. Long has our species sought Spalix, last haven of our once-great nation, and long have we been disappointed. If our service to your gods can grant us this as well, we will gladly throw down our lives, so long as our legacy lives on."

"Very well. I can tell you that what you ask for is what I was told you shall have. Come now, we will journey first to the Crossroads, and from there, Zille will take us where we must go." Vakni produced the key from her pack again, and opened a portal to the Crossroads. The Illithid stepped first through the portal and she followed them through, pressing the curious ones quickly away from the primrose surrounding them, lest more perish before Zille arrived. She pulled the iridescent flower from her pocket and stared at it for a moment, curious as to why Cruxius had asked her to consume a flower to summon a goddess. *Gods forbid he make sense for once*, she thought to herself. She placed the flower in her mouth and chewed the petals quickly. The texture was unpleasant, to say the least, and the several seconds chewing on the fibrous, springy, bitter flower left her altogether disgruntled. She screwed her face in disgust as she tried to swallow the waxy remnants. *This had better not be an attempt to have a laugh at my expense* she thought as she swished aqua animi from her flask in an attempt to wash the flavor from her mouth. *Blech!*

Vakni swallowed the flower, and she suddenly heard giggling. A rich, erotic giggling. "Look up silly" said a voice. Vakni looked up, and flying above her was a beautiful creature. "Whatever you do, don't look down" the creature said. Vakni looked down. The world shifted, and Vakni fell. Her stomach twisted, and the world turned into a blur, rushing colours, stretched out to eternity. Her feet stretched out before her, and the ground fell away. Suddenly there was nothing, but a picture of green, the tops of tiny trees, and minuscule houses, between her feet. Vakni fell, and the ground rushed towards her. She screamed with all her might, her death had come. The trees grew larger, she could see small people among the houses. Vakni closed her eyes, and said a silent prayer to Cruxius. She opened her eyes, and she stood on the ground. An old Hag standing crooked before her. "Easy now" said the old hag. Vakni bent over, and emptied her stomach. Adrenalin coursed through her body, her hands shook, and her stomach dry heaved. "Shouldn't have looked down", said the Hag. "Follow me" he said, as he lead a very dishevelled group, to the centre of the compound. There they found a very dark vortex. "Take these coats" the old Hag said, as a group of Thorac rushed out to meet them, carrying fur coats and boots, headscarves and gloves. "It's rather cold on the other side" he smiled. Vakni put on the gear, in the hot morning sun, with shaking hands, and a sick feeling in her stomach. She followed the Hag, and stepped into the Vortex. An ice wind blasted her face, and a strong hand gripped her arm. "Welcome to the Nasquam" said a voice.
